summary: Scott Perry voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act (May 2024), directing use of the IHRA definition and examples in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. His campaign platform identifies "the war against radical Islamist extremism" as the top national-security priority without addressing the Israeli occupation or Palestinian rights.
